parsed.rationale: All eleven records are unnamed extensions (name: "") on what the cluster_id indicates is `EnvironmentValues`, spread across six distinct packages: `AppServices`, `Playback`, `WXUI`, `Wallpaper`, and `PlayerHeaderView`. In SwiftUI it is idiomatic and required practice for each module to declare its own `extension EnvironmentValues` block to register its own custom environment keys — these extensions are not duplicates of each other but independent, domain-specific additions to the same Swift standard type. The `fields_or_signature` arrays are all empty, so there is no evidence of shared members that could be consolidated. Collapsing these into a single location would couple unrelated packages (`Wallpaper`, `Playback`, `AppServices`, etc.) and violate the module-boundary design the codebase is clearly following. The structural signal here is purely nominal (all extend `EnvironmentValues`) and carries no actionable duplication.
